entire_current48_exercise_literal_record.source_text:
Exercise 11.4 — Scenario design and validation, numerically
      
      
        (a) For $d=1$ show that the Campi–Garatti bound reduces to $(1-\epsilon)^N\le\beta$; compute $N$ for $\epsilon=0.05$, $\beta=10^{-3}$. (b) A common-Lyapunov LMI with $d_x=2$, $d_u=1$ has $n_k=2d_x^2+d_xd_u$ variables. For $\epsilon=0.05$, $\beta=10^{-5}$ compare the exact scenario sample size (calculator) with the sufficient formula. (c) For validation with $\alpha=0.01$, $\epsilon_{\mathrm{val}}=0.02$, compute $M_{\mathrm{val}}$ with the corrected and the misprinted rule; what confidence does the misprinted size give? (d) With $c=0.95$, $\epsilon=0.05$ and (c), what does the corrected theorem guarantee?
        
          Show answer
          
            (a) Only the term $i=0$ remains: $(1-\epsilon)^N\le\beta\iff N\ge\ln(1/\beta)/(-\ln(1-\epsilon))=6.9078/0.051293=134.7$, so $N=135$. With one variable only one sample can support the solution, and a violation above $\epsilon$ needs all $N$ samples to miss an $\epsilon$-mass region.
            (b) $n_k=10$. The binomial tail first drops below $10^{-5}$ at $N=581$ ($9.67\cdot10^{-6}$; at $580$ it is $1.003\cdot10^{-5}$); the sufficient formula gives $\lceil40(\ln10^5+10)\rceil=861$, about 48% more.
            (c) Corrected: $\ln100/(2\cdot0.02^2)=5756.5$, so $5757$. Misprinted: $\ln100/(2\cdot0.02)=115.1$, so $116$, for which $e^{-2\cdot116\cdot0.02^2}=e^{-0.0928}=0.911$: so Hoeffding certifies a confidence of only $1-0.911\approx9\%$, not $99\%$ (a lower bound from this inequality, not the actual confidence of the procedure).
            (d) With probability at least $0.99$ over the validation samples, the posterior probability that $K^\ast$ stabilises the true linearisation is at least $0.95-0.05-0.02=0.88$: a Bayesian statement, as good as the GP posterior.

import SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedDiscountedHorizons
import SafeLearning.CompleteFoundationsExponentialNumerics
import SafeLearning.CompleteAppliedBinomialModel

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option maxRecDepth 10000
set_option exponentiation.threshold 2000
noncomputable section
open Set MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators

namespace SafeLearning.CompleteLyapunovScenarioNumbers23

def binomialMass (n i : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (n.choose i : ℝ) * p ^ i * (1 - p) ^ (n - i)

def lowerTail (n d : ℕ) (p : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range d, binomialMass n i p

private theorem mass_successor (n i : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hi : i + 1 ≤ n) :
    binomialMass (n+1) (i+1) p =
      (1-p)*binomialMass n (i+1) p + p*binomialMass n i p := by
  have he : n-i = (n-(i+1))+1 := by omega
  have he' : n+1-(i+1) = n-i := by omega
  simp only [binomialMass, Nat.choose_succ_succ', Nat.cast_add, he', he, pow_succ]
  ring

private theorem tail_successor_split (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p =
      (1-p)*lowerTail n (m+1) p + p*lowerTail n m p := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp [lowerTail, binomialMass, pow_succ]; ring
  | succ m ih =>
    have hmn : m ≤ n := by omega
    have hs := mass_successor n m p (by omega)
    simp only [lowerTail, Finset.sum_range_succ] at ih ⊢
    have hh := ih hmn
    rw [hs]
    linarith

theorem actual_binomial_tail_successor_identity (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ) (hm : m ≤ n) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p =
      lowerTail n (m+1) p - p*binomialMass n m p := by
  rw [tail_successor_split n m p hm]
  have he : lowerTail n (m+1) p = lowerTail n m p + binomialMass n m p := by
    simp [lowerTail, Finset.sum_range_succ]
  rw [he]
  ring

theorem actual_binomial_tail_nonincrease (n m : ℕ) (p : ℝ)
    (hm : m ≤ n) (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    lowerTail (n+1) (m+1) p ≤ lowerTail n (m+1) p := by
  rw [actual_binomial_tail_successor_identity n m p hm]
  have hn : 0 ≤ p*binomialMass n m p := by
    unfold binomialMass
    positivity
  linarith

theorem actual_ten_term_tail_antitone_from_nine :
    Antitone (fun k : ℕ => lowerTail (k+9) 10 (1/20)) := by
  apply antitone_nat_of_succ_le
  intro k
  convert actual_binomial_tail_nonincrease (k+9) 9 (1/20) (by omega)
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) using 1

theorem actual_dimension_one_reduction (n : ℕ) (p : ℝ) :
    lowerTail n 1 p = (1-p)^n := by simp [lowerTail,binomialMass]

theorem actual_independent_count_lower_tail_probability
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (n d : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Set Ω) (hA : ∀ i,MeasurableSet (A i))
    (hind : iIndepSet A P) (p : ℝ) (hp : ∀ i,P.real (A i)=p) :
    P.real {w | CompleteAppliedFailureCounts.failureCount A w < d}=lowerTail n d p := by
  classical
  have he : {w | CompleteAppliedFailureCounts.failureCount A w < d}=
      ⋃ i∈Finset.range d,{w | CompleteAppliedFailureCounts.failureCount A w=i} := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq,Set.mem_iUnion,Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · intro h;exact ⟨_,h,rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨i,hi,he⟩;omega
  have hd : Set.PairwiseDisjoint (Finset.range d : Set ℕ)
      (fun i=>{w | CompleteAppliedFailureCounts.failureCount A w=i}) := by
    intro i hi j hj hij
    apply Set.disjoint_left.mpr
    intro w hwi hwj
    exact hij (hwi.symm.trans hwj)
  rw [he,measureReal_biUnion_finset hd
    (fun i _ => (measurableSet_singleton i).preimage
      (CompleteAppliedBinomialModel.failure_count_measurable A hA))]
  unfold lowerTail
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact CompleteAppliedBinomialModel.actual_binomial_count_mass P n A hA hind p hp i

theorem actual_one_dimensional_boundary_and_rounding :
    (1/1000:ℝ)<(19/20)^134 ∧ (19/20:ℝ)^135<1/1000 ∧
      |Real.log 1000/Real.log (20/19)-1347/10|<1/20 := by
  obtain ⟨hl,hu,_,_⟩ :=
    CompleteAppliedDiscountedHorizons.actual_discount_log_enclosure_and_log_hundred_enclosure
  obtain ⟨_,_,h100l,h100u⟩ :=
    CompleteAppliedDiscountedHorizons.actual_discount_log_enclosure_and_log_hundred_enclosure
  have he1000 : Real.log 1000=(3/2:ℝ)*Real.log 100 := by
    have he : Real.log 1000=3*Real.log 10 := by
      rw [show (1000:ℝ)=(10:ℝ)^3 by norm_num,Real.log_pow]; norm_num
    have he' : Real.log 100=2*Real.log 10 := by
      rw [show (100:ℝ)=(10:ℝ)^2 by norm_num,Real.log_pow]; norm_num
    linarith
  have h1000l : (6907754/1000000:ℝ)<Real.log 1000 := by rw [he1000]; linarith
  have h1000u : Real.log 1000<(6907756/1000000:ℝ) := by rw [he1000]; linarith
  have hd : 0<Real.log (20/19:ℝ) := by linarith
  refine ⟨by norm_num,by norm_num,?_⟩
  rw [abs_lt]
  constructor
  · have h := (lt_div_iff₀ hd).mpr
      (show (1347/10-1/20)*Real.log (20/19)<Real.log 1000 by linarith)
    linarith
  · have h := (div_lt_iff₀ hd).mpr
      (show Real.log 1000<(1347/10+1/20)*Real.log (20/19) by linarith)
    linarith

theorem actual_least_one_dimensional_sample_size (n : ℕ) :
    lowerTail n 1 (1/20) ≤ 1/1000 ↔ 135 ≤ n := by
  rw [actual_dimension_one_reduction]
  norm_num only [show (1-(1/20:ℝ))=19/20 by norm_num]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hh
    have hn : n ≤ 134 := by omega
    have hm := pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤19/20)
      (by norm_num : (19/20:ℝ)≤1) hn
    exact not_le_of_gt actual_one_dimensional_boundary_and_rounding.1 (hm.trans h)
  · intro hn
    exact (pow_le_pow_of_le_one (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)≤19/20)
      (by norm_num : (19/20:ℝ)≤1) hn).trans
      actual_one_dimensional_boundary_and_rounding.2.1.le

theorem actual_one_dimensional_logarithmic_threshold (n : ℕ) :
    lowerTail n 1 (1/20) ≤ 1/1000 ↔
      Real.log 1000/Real.log (20/19) ≤ (n:ℝ) := by
  rw [actual_dimension_one_reduction]
  have hd : 0<Real.log (20/19:ℝ) := Real.log_pos (by norm_num)
  have hi : Real.log (1-(1/20:ℝ))= -Real.log (20/19) := by
    rw [show (1-(1/20:ℝ))=(20/19)⁻¹ by norm_num,Real.log_inv]
  have hb : Real.log (1/1000:ℝ)= -Real.log 1000 := by
    rw [show (1/1000:ℝ)=(1000:ℝ)⁻¹ by norm_num,Real.log_inv]
  rw [←Real.log_le_log_iff (pow_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<1-1/20) n)
    (by norm_num),Real.log_pow,hi,hb,div_le_iff₀ hd]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

theorem actual_ten_variable_boundary_enclosures :
    (10030776/10^12:ℝ)<lowerTail 580 10 (1/20) ∧
      lowerTail 580 10 (1/20)<10030778/10^12 ∧
      (9672779/10^12:ℝ)<lowerTail 581 10 (1/20) ∧

    |lowerTail 581 10 (1/20)-967/10^8|<1/(2*10^8) ∧

def empirical {Ω : Type*} (n : ℕ) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (w : Ω) : ℝ :=
  (1/(n:ℝ))*∑ i,X i w

private theorem bounded_average_upper_tail
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0<n) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (m epsilon : ℝ)
    (he : 0≤epsilon) (hInd : iIndepFun X P)
    (hm : ∀ i,AEMeasurable (X i) P)
    (hb : ∀ i,∀ᵐ w ∂P,X i w∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∀ i,∫ w,X i w ∂P = m) :
    P.real {w | epsilon≤empirical n X w-m}≤Real.exp (-2*(n:ℝ)*epsilon^2) := by
  let Y : Fin n → Ω → ℝ := fun i w=>X i w-m
  have hi : iIndepFun Y P := hInd.comp (fun (_:Fin n) (x:ℝ)=>x-m)
    (fun _=>measurable_id.sub_const m)
  have hsg : ∀i,HasSubgaussianMGF (Y i) (1/4) P := by
    intro i
    have h := CompleteAppliedConcentration.centered_unit_interval_subgaussian P (X i) (hm i) (hb i)
    simpa only [hmean i] using h
  have hs : HasSubgaussianMGF (fun w=>∑i,Y i w) ((n:ℝ≥0)/4) P := by
    simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using HasSubgaussianMGF.sum_of_iIndepFun hi
      (s:=Finset.univ) (c:=fun _=>(1/4:ℝ≥0)) (fun i _=>hsg i)
  have hnreal : (0:ℝ)<n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have ht := hs.measure_ge_le (mul_nonneg hnreal.le he)
  have hset : {w | epsilon≤empirical n X w-m}=
      {w | (n:ℝ)*epsilon≤∑i,Y i w} := by
    ext w
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have heq : empirical n X w-m=(1/(n:ℝ))*∑i,Y i w := by
      simp only [empirical,Y,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,
        Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
      field_simp
    rw [heq,one_div_mul_eq_div,le_div_iff₀ hnreal,mul_comm epsilon (n:ℝ)]
  have hexp : -((n:ℝ)*epsilon)^2/(2*((((n:ℝ≥0)/4):ℝ≥0):ℝ))=
      -2*(n:ℝ)*epsilon^2 := by
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hexp] at ht
  rw [hset]
  exact ht

theorem actual_corrected_validation_samples_certify_the_population_lower_mean
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 5757≤n) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (hInd : iIndepFun X P) (hm : ∀i,Measurable (X i))
    (hb : ∀i,∀ᵐ w ∂P,X i w∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∀i,∫w,X i w ∂P = m) :
    (99/100:ℝ)≤P.real {w | empirical n X w-1/50≤ m} := by
  have ht := bounded_average_upper_tail P n (by omega) X m (1/50) (by norm_num)
    hInd (fun i=>(hm i).aemeasurable) hb hmean
  have he : Real.exp (-2*(n:ℝ)*(1/50)^2)≤1/100 := by
    obtain ⟨_,_,hl,hu⟩ :=
      CompleteAppliedDiscountedHorizons.actual_discount_log_enclosure_and_log_hundred_enclosure
    have hnreal : (5757:ℝ)≤n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    have hlog : Real.log 100≤2*(n:ℝ)*(1/50)^2 := by linarith
    rw [show (1/100:ℝ)=Real.exp (-Real.log 100) by
      rw [Real.exp_neg,Real.exp_log (by norm_num)];norm_num,Real.exp_le_exp]
    linarith
  have hbadMeas : MeasurableSet {w | m<empirical n X w-1/50} :=
    measurableSet_lt measurable_const
      ((measurable_const.mul (Finset.measurable_sum Finset.univ (fun i _=>hm i))).sub_const _)
  have hbad : P.real {w | m<empirical n X w-1/50}≤1/100 := by
    apply (measureReal_mono (μ:=P) (show {w | m<empirical n X w-1/50}⊆
      {w | (1/50:ℝ)≤empirical n X w-m} by intro w hw;dsimp at hw ⊢;linarith)).trans
    exact ht.trans he
  have hc := probReal_compl_eq_one_sub (μ:=P) hbadMeas
  have hset : {w | m<empirical n X w-1/50}ᶜ={w | empirical n X w-1/50≤ m} := by
    ext w;simp
  rw [hset] at hc
  linarith

theorem actual_accepted_fixed_validation_certifies_point_nine_three
    {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 5757≤n) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (m : ℝ)
    (hInd : iIndepFun X P) (hm : ∀i,Measurable (X i))
    (hb : ∀i,∀ᵐ w ∂P,X i w∈Icc (0:ℝ) 1)
    (hmean : ∀i,∫w,X i w ∂P = m) :
    (99/100:ℝ)≤P.real {w | (19/20≤empirical n X w)→93/100≤ m} := by
  have h := actual_corrected_validation_samples_certify_the_population_lower_mean
    P n hn X m hInd hm hb hmean
  exact h.trans (measureReal_mono (μ:=P) (by
    intro w hw hh;change empirical n X w-1/50≤ m at hw;linarith))

theorem actual_normalized_credible_region_transfers_stability_to_full_belief
    {Θ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Θ] (posterior : Measure Θ) [IsProbabilityMeasure posterior]
    (credible stable : Set Θ) (hc : posterior.real credible=19/20)
    (hm : (93/100:ℝ)≤posterior.real (credible∩stable)/posterior.real credible) :
    (1767/2000:ℝ)≤posterior.real stable ∧ (22/25:ℝ)≤posterior.real stable := by
  have hm' : (1767/2000:ℝ)≤posterior.real (credible∩stable) := by
    rw [hc,le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<19/20)] at hm
    nlinarith
  have hs := measureReal_mono (μ:=posterior) (inter_subset_right : credible∩stable⊆stable)
  constructor
  · exact hm'.trans hs
  · linarith [hm'.trans hs]

theorem actual_independent_normalized_posterior_validation_has_point_eight_eight_confidence
    {Ω Θ : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Θ]
    (P : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    (posterior : Measure Θ) [IsProbabilityMeasure posterior]
    (credible stable : Set Θ) (hc : posterior.real credible=19/20)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 5757≤n) (X : Fin n → Ω → ℝ) (p : unitInterval)
    (hp : (p:ℝ)=posterior.real (credible∩stable)/posterior.real credible)
    (hInd : iIndepFun X P) (hm : ∀i,Measurable (X i))
    (hLaw : ∀i,HasLaw (X i) (bernoulliMeasure (1:ℝ) 0 p) P) :
    (99/100:ℝ)≤P.real {w | (19/20≤empirical n X w)→22/25≤posterior.real stable} := by
  have hs := actual_accepted_fixed_validation_certifies_point_nine_three
    P n hn X p hInd hm
    (fun i=>(CompleteAppliedValidation.bernoulli_support_mean P (X i) p (hLaw i)).1)
    (fun i=>(CompleteAppliedValidation.bernoulli_support_mean P (X i) p (hLaw i)).2)
  exact hs.trans (measureReal_mono (μ:=P) (by
    intro w hw hh
    have hpop := hw hh
    rw [hp] at hpop
    exact (actual_normalized_credible_region_transfers_stability_to_full_belief
      posterior credible stable hc hpop).2))

theorem actual_source_logarithm_roundings_and_strict_numerical_inequalities :
    |Real.log 1000-69078/10000|<1/20000 ∧
      |Real.log (20/19)-51293/1000000|<1/2000000 ∧
      Real.log 1000/Real.log (20/19)<1347/10 ∧
      Real.log 1000≠69078/10000 ∧
      Real.log (20/19)≠51293/1000000 ∧
      Real.log 1000/Real.log (20/19)≠1347/10 := by
  obtain ⟨hl,hu,h100l,h100u⟩ :=
    CompleteAppliedDiscountedHorizons.actual_discount_log_enclosure_and_log_hundred_enclosure
  have hlog : Real.log 1000=(3/2:ℝ)*Real.log 100 := by
    have h1 : Real.log 1000=3*Real.log 10 := by
      rw [show (1000:ℝ)=10^3 by norm_num,Real.log_pow];norm_num
    have h2 : Real.log 100=2*Real.log 10 := by
      rw [show (100:ℝ)=10^2 by norm_num,Real.log_pow];norm_num
    linarith
  have hd : 0<Real.log (20/19:ℝ) := by linarith
  have hr : Real.log 1000/Real.log (20/19)<1347/10 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ hd).mpr
    rw [hlog]
    linarith
  refine ⟨?_,?_,hr,?_,?_,ne_of_lt hr⟩
  · rw [hlog,abs_lt];constructor <;> linarith
  · rw [abs_lt];constructor <;> linarith
  · rw [hlog];intro h;linarith
  · intro h;linarith
